lead: Pincoro General Incorporated Association ("we") handles users' personal information in the scheduling service "Kimaru" (the "Service") in accordance with the following policy.
s1.p: Account information (name, email address, login method); Google integration information (profile and, where permitted, Google Calendar free/busy and event information, plus data needed to create events and issue Google Meet links); booking information (booking date/time, meeting method, pre-meeting questionnaire answers, and an optional, hideable date of birth); usage records (meeting logs, contact-management notes and ratings, access logs, cookie and session information, and screen-usage records collected to improve the service: the type of screen viewed, device type, language, and the host name of an external referrer (including the referrer recorded at sign-up); we do not store raw URLs or IP addresses); AI connection information (whether the MCP connection is enabled and an identifier used to revoke it; we do not obtain your AI service account credentials); and payment information (processed via a payment provider; we do not retain card numbers).
s2.p: We use information to provide the Service (scheduling, calendar integration, booking management, notifications), to support relationship-building based on pre-meeting questionnaires and date of birth, to support meeting preparation through an external AI service the user has connected (MCP connection), to prevent misuse and properly operate the invite code (Cat Key), and for service improvement and statistical analysis in a non-identifiable form.
s3.p: Except as required by law, we do not provide information to third parties without the user's consent. Within the scope of the purposes above, we use the following external services: Google (OAuth/Calendar/Meet for authentication, calendar integration, and event/Meet issuance), Supabase (database and data storage), Square (payment processing for paid plans; card details are processed by Square), Resend (sending emails such as booking confirmations and reminders), and Zoom (only when you enable the Zoom connection: based on your authorization, we create meetings on your own Zoom account, update them on reschedule, and delete them on cancellation; access tokens are stored encrypted and deleted promptly when you disconnect or uninstall the app on Zoom's side). In addition, with the Premium plan's MCP connection, contact data such as bookings, questionnaire answers, and profiles is sent to the external AI service you have connected (such as OpenAI's ChatGPT or Anthropic's Claude) based on your own actions (see "5. Handling of the External AI Connection (MCP)" for details).
s4.h: 4. Handling of Google User Data (Limited Use)
s4.link: Google API Services User Data Policy
s4.p: The Service's use and transfer of information obtained from Google APIs complies with the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. Calendar information is used only to provide the Service's features and is not used for advertising purposes.
s5.p: We retain collected information for as long as needed to provide the Service. Users may request account deletion, upon which related information is appropriately erased (except where retention is legally required). Google integration can be disconnected at any time. Access tokens and similar data are stored encrypted.
s5ai.h: 5. Handling of the External AI Connection (MCP)
s5ai.p: The Premium plan's MCP connection is a feature that lets you connect an external AI service you subscribe to (such as OpenAI's ChatGPT or Anthropic's Claude) to the Service. With this connection, no AI processing takes place on our servers, and we never send data automatically: data is sent only in response to requests you make from your AI service after connecting. The information that may be sent includes personal information of third parties, such as a guest's name, email address, pre-meeting questionnaire answers, and meeting notes. You are responsible for sending such information to the AI service you have chosen, including obtaining any consent required, and we are not responsible for how that AI service handles the data after it is sent. The connection takes effect only when a Premium user explicitly enables it, and it can be revoked at any time from the "AI Assist" screen of the Service (revoking invalidates every connection already issued). The connection uses signed tokens issued by us, and we do not obtain your account credentials for the AI service. If you are a guest and wish to request disclosure or deletion of your information, please contact the inquiry desk below or the user (host) you met with.
s6.p: Upon the user's request, we respond to disclosure, correction, deletion, and suspension of use of retained personal data. Please contact us at the inquiry desk below.
s7.p: We use cookies to maintain login state (sessions). The screen-usage records we collect to improve the service do not use cookies; identifiers are converted into values that change daily, so we do not track visitors across days.
